integrity: Analytical derivation accompanies the exact formulas; finite numerical checks are corroboration, not a proof. Prior spherical-segment and icosahedral packing and covering facts are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: The theorem describes a fixed, regular twelve-point site set on the Euclidean unit sphere, not every twelve-point configuration.
The exact average squared-chord loss is not asserted to be a globally minimal quantization loss.
No finite-sample stability, historical-priority certification, or independent audit is established.
title: The exact nearest-direction law of the regular icosahedron
